title: Brightly colored, a little small
text:
Brightly colored, a little small. Simple, plain can coozies that quietly do their jobs.
I am not sure how they fit regular 12 ounce cans, as I don't have any my photo is with a "mini" can, which is 7.5 ounces. The minis come right to the top of the cozy.
These would be perfect for around a pool to keep cans colder.
